in_sanskrit.name: Dharisha
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'dhar' meaning 'to hold, to bear, to support', and the feminine suffix 'isha'

in_marathi.name: Dharisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dharma’, which means righteousness, law, duty, and moral values. The name Dharisha signifies the Goddess who upholds the principles of dharma and instills them in people.
